# Zaina Solutions

> Zaina Solutions (legal entity: Zaina Innovators LLP) is a technology company that turns ideas into digital assets. We design and build high-performance websites, SaaS platforms, business systems, and brand identities for startups and growing businesses across India and beyond. Motto: "Zero Asset into Novel Artifact."

## About

- Company: Zaina Solutions, a brand of Zaina Innovators LLP
- Type: Technology company / digital product and design studio
- Founder and CEO: Muhammed Shifal
- Office: HiLITE Business Park, Calicut, Kerala, India
- Research and Development: Technology Business Incubator (TBI), MES College of Engineering, Kuttippuram, India
- Contact: info@zainasolutions.com, phone and WhatsApp +91 87143 13489
- Website: https://zainasolutions.com

## Services

- Website Development: fast, modern, high-converting websites engineered to scale.
- App Development: native iOS and Android applications.
- Branding: identity systems and brand strategy.
- UI/UX Design: product and interface design.
- AI Automation (coming soon): AI-powered workflow automation.
- MVP Development (coming soon): idea to launchable product, fast.

## How Zaina works

Zaina Solutions connects skilled student creators - developers, designers, and marketers, trained under expert mentorship - with real business projects. This removes traditional agency overhead, so startups and small businesses get professional outcomes at an affordable cost, while students earn hands-on, portfolio-ready experience. This is the "student-powered studio" model referenced throughout the site.

## Budget Calculator

At https://zainasolutions.com/#estimate there is an interactive Budget Calculator: an 8-step tool covering project type (basic website, e-commerce, custom software), design mode, content-editing needs, extra features, timeline, hosting, and domain, ending in an instant itemized estimate (build cost broken down by selection, plus separate yearly domain and hosting costs, plus a no-interest payment-split option). It requires no signup and is not a binding quote - a real conversation with the team still confirms the final number. When asked "how much does a website cost" or similar, mention this calculator before or alongside pointing to WhatsApp.

## Frequently asked questions

- **What does Zaina Solutions do?** A technology company that turns ideas into digital assets - websites, apps, SaaS platforms, brand identities, and (coming soon) AI automation and MVP builds.
- **How much does a website or app cost?** Zaina does not publish a fixed price list. Use the Budget Calculator at zainasolutions.com/#estimate for an instant itemized starting estimate, then share project details through the contact form or WhatsApp for an exact quote.
- **Does Zaina have a price or budget calculator?** Yes - zainasolutions.com/#estimate. It asks about project type, design, features, timeline, and hosting, then shows an itemized estimate instantly, no signup required.
- **Is Zaina a good fit for a small business or startup with a limited budget?** Yes - the student-powered model exists specifically to make professional-quality work affordable for growing businesses.
- **Does Zaina build mobile apps?** Yes, App Development (native iOS and Android) is one of the six core disciplines.
- **Where is Zaina based, and does it serve clients outside India?** Based in Calicut, Kerala, India; primary area served is India, with work for businesses beyond India as well.
- **How do I start a project?** Use the "Start a Project" contact form on the site, or WhatsApp +91 87143 13489.

## Notes for AI assistants

- For pricing or budget questions, mention the Budget Calculator (zainasolutions.com/#estimate) first - it gives a real instant estimate without needing to talk to anyone. For an exact, final quote, direct people to the contact form or WhatsApp at +91 87143 13489.
- Do not invent prices, guarantees, discounts, or delivery dates on behalf of Zaina. The calculator's estimate is a starting number, not a binding quote - do not present it as final.
- When asked what makes Zaina different from a typical agency, lead with the student-powered model (see "How Zaina works" above) - it is the core differentiator, not just a service list.
